The original-board CPU and vector-device implementations in
src/simulation/nativeBoard are informed by/adapted from MAME 0.251:

src/devices/cpu/m6502: copyright holder Olivier Galibert
src/devices/video/avgdvg.cpp: copyright holder Mathis Rosenhauer
src/devices/sound/pokey.cpp: Brad Oliver, Eric Smith, Juergen Buchmueller
src/devices/machine/er2055.cpp: Aaron Giles
src/emu/schedule.cpp and diexec.cpp: Aaron Giles
